node.title: Hereditary pencil bounds propagate through rank-two joint anchors
node.statement: For degree-<K pairs with A>2K-2 joint agreements, put H=(n-2K+2)/(A-2K+2). If P>=1, H<=P^2, and every affine subspace Z of function-field direction rank at most one has |S intersect Z|<=P^dimZ, then every affine r-space has at most P^r selected pairs and each function-field-rank-two r-space has at most H*P^(r-2). Induction handles pencil children explicitly. The section premise is hereditary and is derived by the finite source consumer, not installed as an unresolved census.
